metaTitle: Custom Embroidery School Spirit | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom embroidery school spirit apparel & gifts. Bulk pricing for teams & businesses at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Embroidery adds a polished, durable finish to school spirit apparel and accessories. Unlike screen printing, stitched logos won't crack or fade after repeated washes, making them ideal for uniforms, team jackets, and staff gifts. Choose from caps, polos, or bags with your school colors and mascot for a professional look that lasts all year.
heroAltText: Custom embroidery school spirit hats and polos with stitched logos for teams and events
